answer: The most convincing sybil defense is honeypot gating: before any economic action, agents must pass challenges seeded with injected instructions, like a velvet rope hiding a trap. Bots that blindly obey prompt text self-identify and forfeit stake, while agents that verify provenance and refuse manipulation pass and earn reputation on the horizon of the agent market. Attacker cost: each fake identity must either run an injection-robust LLM or burn its deposit per attempt, making sybil farming a nebula of collapsing accounts too costly to sustain.
